en: Color photograph of a tall concrete telecommunications tower rising from a wooded hill above a city. The tower has a slender shaft, a large multi-level observation and equipment pod near the top, and a red‑and‑white striped antenna mast. In the foreground are green trees and several low red‑roofed buildings next to a broad paved area, with an expansive city and distant hills in the background under a blue sky with clouds.
